name: Bakunyuu Juku Tsuma wa Yokkyuu Fuman ~Geshuku no Erokawa Kanrinin-san wa Boku Sen'you no Shorigakari!
original_name: 爆乳熟妻は欲求不満 ～下宿のエロカワ管理人さんは僕専用の処理係！
source:
The endowed owner of a vacation hotel is burning up with hormonal urges! Her ripe chest and cherry need to be satisfied, but she's not getting enough! Your relationship with the mistress depends on your choices! Will she be a sex friend or something more? 

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE084055.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
天生巨乳的度假旅館老闆娘，體內慾火正旺！她成熟飽滿的雙乳與蜜穴都渴求滿足，卻怎麼也喂不飽！你自己的選擇，會決定你和老闆娘的關係！她會成為你的炮友，還是與你發展出更深的關係？
